sara (finance): FluxMeter pricing follow-up. Their quote mixes committed bundles, overage multipliers, and a per-request telemetry line. Can we list exact clarifying questions before I send the PO?
josh (procurement): From the quote: committed-100k @ $0.0004/token, overage multiplier x1.5, telemetry-event $0.00005/event. Sounds like telemetry might still be charged on committed plan. Need to confirm.
rachel (eng-ml): Also need to know how streaming is billed. Do they count tokens + sessions? If there's a session fee + per-token, that can be worse for tty/chat.
sara (finance): Their SKU excerpt (redacted):
```
SKU,Unit,Price,Notes
CM-TOKEN,token,0.0004,committed rate up to bundle
OV-TOKEN,token,0.0006,post-commit overage
TM-EVENT,event,0.00005,telemetry/ingress
SESSION,session,0.01,per-active-stream
```
They also show a "discounted reserved" row with a monthly fee + credits.
david (legal): Please confirm invoice timing, net terms, currency, and VAT handling. Also require 30-day dispute window and that overage math is auditable (raw logs).
sam (security): Ask whether telemetry includes prompt text; their security page is vague. Do they offer prompt redaction or masking before storage? KMS for logs?
rachel (eng-ml): For reconciliation we need: 1) line-level CSV export (request_id, timestamp_utc, model, token_in, token_out, session_id, telemetry_events), 2) timezone in UTC, 3) per-request cost breakdown (which SKU applied).
josh (procurement): Add question on proration if we upgrade/downgrade committed bundle mid-cycle, and whether overage multipliers apply during trial periods. Also clarify whether reserved credits expire or roll over.
sara (finance): Also want sample math for three scenarios:
- small synchronous completion (100 tokens in + 400 tokens out),
- streaming chat session (15 messages, avg 50 tokens out per message),
- batch embeddings job (100k embedding units).
Please have them show line-by-line invoice items and the CSV row that would map to each charge.
fluxmeter-bot: FluxMeter AE: "Thanks — attaching sample invoice PDF and CSV. For streaming we bill session+tokens, but session can be waived for committed customers. Overages use OV-TOKEN rate; proration is pro-rata and credits can roll month-to-month up to 3 months. We support SAML, SOC2, and can enable KMS redaction on request."
sara (finance): Good. Priorities: High = sample invoice + per-request CSV + confirmation that session fee can be waived for committed customers. Medium = proration & rollover policy. Low = residency details.
josh (procurement): I'll draft the email replies and include a request for the sample computations. Anyone want to add language for audit logs?
david (legal): I'll draft audit clause + 30-day dispute window. Share with me the sample invoice when you get it.
sara (finance): Thanks — once Josh posts the consolidated questions I'll approve and send. :thumbsup:
